name: OpenSSH on Ubuntu 22.04
description: Ubuntu 22.04 ships OpenSSH 8.9p1 — tests backport-aware detection

command: apt-get update && apt-get install -y openssh-server && mkdir /run/sshd && echo 'root:root' | chpasswd && sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && /usr/sbin/sshd -D
